turns.question: Our books close on Amsterdam time. What was our revenue in September 2026, cancelled orders left out, counting each order on its calendar day in Amsterdam?
turns.answer: Revenue for September 2026 (1-30 Sep, cancelled orders excluded) was EUR 12,582.75, but the semantic layer can only count orders on their UTC calendar day, not Amsterdam days, so orders near midnight may fall on a different day than in your books. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
